description: PowerFlex is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Öko-Institut e.V.. PowerFlex is a linear optimization model of the European electricity market used to calculate the cost-optimal deployment of generation, storage, and flexibility options, such as heat pumps or electric vehicles, to meet electricity and district heating demand as well as to provide balancing power. Coverage: EU27+UK+NO+CH-CY-MT. Methodical focus: energy system optimisation. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
